As a Senior Consultant at Veeva, you will help major pharmaceutical and biotech companies organize and manage their customer and product data. You will design and implement Veeva Network MDM to give clients a single, accurate view of their doctors, hospitals, and business partners across multiple sources.

You will act as the lead solution architect and project driver. You will work directly with clients to understand their needs, design the system setup, and lead a small internal team of technical specialists to build and deliver the solution on time.

How You Will Spend Your Time
50% Data Analysis & Solution Design: Meeting with clients, analyzing their data needs, and designing how the software should be set up.
30% Technical Architecture: High-level platform configuration, mapping data flows, and making sure integrations work correctly.
20% Project Leadership: Keeping projects on schedule, managing risks, and coaching junior team members.

Lead Customer Projects: Run software implementation projects from start to finish for global healthcare and life sciences clients
Design Data Solutions: Set up the platform to track healthcare professionals, organizations, and product data. Help clients combine their internal data sources into a single source of truth
Connect Systems: Connect Veeva Network MDM to Vault CRM so sales teams in the field can easily request data updates and view accurate customer profiles
Configure Portals and Widgets: Set up user-friendly dashboards and widgets so business users can easily search and access the data they need
Advise Stakeholders: Run workshops and present your designs clearly to client managers and stakeholders, translating technical data concepts into plain business language
Improve the Team: Help train junior consultants and create reusable templates and guides to make future implementations faster and better

Consulting Experience: 5+ years of software consulting or professional services experience leading customer-facing technology implementations
MDM Software Skills: 3+ years of hands-on experience configuring Veeva Network MDM or a similar major master data management system (like Reltio or Informatica)
Data Tech Basics: Solid understanding of data integration tools, including SQL, ETL processes, APIs, and CSV/FTP file transfers
Project Delivery: Experience working with structured project timelines (like Agile or Scrum) and managing project tasks
Communication: Excellent presentation and writing skills. You must be comfortable leading meetings and managing client relationships
Travel & Education: Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) and the ability to travel 20-30% for client meetings
Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Veeva does not provide visa sponsorship for this role

Prior experience working in or consulting for the pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industries

As a Product Engagement Manager on the User Operations team, you will lead a team of Product Engagement Specialists responsible for ensuring smooth, successful product launches across internal and external teams. You’ll be the glue connecting product teams and support operations, equipping teams with the tools and knowledge needed to support new product rollouts.
You’ll build scalable feedback loops that capture the voice of the user and translate insights into actionable product improvements, and ensure that frontline teams have the knowledge and skills to deliver accurate, delightful customer interactions at scale.
We’re looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of product management, team enablement, and customer advocacy, and who enjoys working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, evolving environment. This person will manage the day-to-day work while also helping architect the systems needed to scale it.
The successful candidate will be a leader-coach who can lead a small team while continuing to perform individual contributor work.
This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

Lead a team coordinating product launches across internal and external teams, ensuring seamless execution and support readiness.
Set the team’s strategy and priorities, translate them into clear goals and quality standards, and allocate capacity to deliver against them.
Build a high-performing team through ongoing coaching, feedback, development, and performance management.
Build out a Voice of the User program with scalable feedback loops between support, Product, and Engineering pre and post launch, so customer insights inform product development and strategy.
Advocate for users by representing their needs and pain points in product and engineering discussions.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations to align on launch goals and timelines.
Monitor post-launch performance and gather support data to assess product impact and inform improvements.
Document and standardize launch procedures to make them repeatable and scalable.
Identify launch risks and propose solutions that minimize disruption to customers.
Report on feedback-loop performance, including key insights, trends, and recommendations for the product roadmap.

s.t:
Have experience leading product enablement or launch-readiness functions at scale, particularly in a customer support environment.
Have shipped tooling or automations that reduced manual work and scaled beyond a single team (workflows, dashboards, scripted automation, lightweight pipelines)."
Have experience in product management with automation and tool development, using metrics and feedback to improve decisions and processes.
Build strong cross-functional relationships with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams.
Are passionate about customer advocacy and can translate customer feedback into strategic product insights.
Are highly organized and able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines.
Communicate technical concepts and customer pain points clearly to diverse audiences.
Take ownership of initiatives from ideation through implementation and post-launch analysis.
Thrive in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

As a Strategic Engagement Manager within our Product & Technology organization, you will serve as a strategic liaison and the connective tissue between the AMP organization, our high-priority enterprise customers, and our global delivery partners.

This is a non-technical, highly strategic enablement role designed to streamline execution, manage the rhythm of business, and maximize relationship health for AMP initiatives.In this role, you will not carry a commercial or sales quota.

Instead, you will act as a dedicated advocate and an internal connector—collaborating directly with Delivery, Sales, and Product leadership to unlock new opportunities, synthesize market insights, and ensure absolute cross-functional accountability across our critical AMP accounts and partnerships.

· Help prepare for high-priority customer and partner meetings — crafting thoughtful briefings, coordinating input from internal stakeholders, and ensuring clear follow-up and accountability

· Join customer and partner meetings acting as an advocate for the customer and a connector between the Delivery, Sales, and Product teams

· Build a deep understanding of MongoDB’s strategic accounts, identifying patterns, opportunities, and challenges that inform company strategy

· Proactively monitor customer and partner announcements, market developments, and industry signals to identify moments where MongoDB can re-engage strategically. Surface relevant insights to help initiate timely outreach to executive customer or partner stakeholders

· Help define consistent reporting of ongoing projects, status and implementation

What Success Looks Like

· First 30 Days: Foundation & Alignment

· Deep Product & Account Familiarity: Complete onboarding to deeply understand MongoDB's strategic accounts, partner ecosystem, and internal delivery workflows

· Relationship Building: Establish strong working relationships with key stakeholders across Sales, Account Executives, Delivery, and Customer Success teams

· Operational Baseline: Assume responsibility for tracking ongoing projects and start defining a consistent reporting structure for implementation status

· First 90 Days: Operational Excellence

· Meeting Readiness: Independently craft comprehensive briefing materials and coordinate internal stakeholder alignment for high-priority customer and partner meetings

· Cross-Functional Orchestration: Serve as an active connector during client sessions, ensuring clear accountability and swift post-meeting follow-up

· Market Intelligence: Establish a proactive monitoring cadence for partner announcements and industry signals, successfully identifying new strategic re-engagement windows

· First Year: Strategic Impact

· Reference & Partner Enablement: Successfully orchestrate the cross-functional coordination required to advance key strategic accounts into fully referenceable champions

· Account Acceleration: Directly contribute to revenue and signing milestones by unlocking friction points, identifying patterns, and surfacing actionable insights within strategic accounts

· Streamlined Reporting: Fully implement and maintain a predictable reporting framework that gives leadership complete visibility into ongoing project health and partner engagement

· Experience: 3–5+ years owning strategic programs portfolios with direct accountability and cross-functional initiatives

· Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving: Ability to structure and synthesize ambiguous information into clear insights and actionable recommendations

· Customer Orientation: Deep empathy for customer needs and the ability to translate those into business outcomes

· Executive Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to interact with senior executives and customers with polish and confidence

· Collaboration & Influence: Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to drive alignment across multiple teams

· Bias for Action: Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and has a high sense of urgency to get things done

· Technical & Market Acumen: Proficiency with Salesforce and Tableau for data tracking, combined with an interest in software/AI technology and the ability to leverage Generative AI tools for market research and executive briefings

· Travel: Travel required to support customer and partner meetings

Aufgaben

s.h: Der Job als Consultant bei uns sieht ungefähr wie folgt aus
s.t:
Account Management & Sales: Du lernst bei uns den Kundenkontakt von Grund auf – Cold Calling, Networking, aber auch die Pflege bestehender Kundenbeziehungen gehören zu deinem Gebiet.
Recruiting: Du lernst die HR-Seite aus der Perspektive einer Beratung kennen: Interviews, Assessments, Profiling und Beratungsgespräche.
Projektmanagement: Du arbeitest 360 Grad – das heißt, du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für deine Projekte (sobald du so weit bist). Du betreust sowohl Kunden als auch Kandidaten und stellst am Ende das perfekte Match her.
Qualifikation
Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du Folgendes mitbringen:
Hunger: Das ist ein Sales-Job – wenn du nicht ein bisschen die "Wolf of Wall Street"-Mentalität mitbringst, wird es bei uns schwer. Wir sind alle sehr ambitioniert – die einen träumen vom 911er, die anderen vom Haus auf Bali für Mama und Papa. Jeder hat sein eigenes Ziel – wichtig ist nur, dass du intrinsische Motivation mitbringst.
Sprachliche Fähigkeiten: Deutsch ist ein Muss, Englisch solltest du mindestens auf B2-Niveau sprechen und offen dafür sein, dich eigenständig weiterzuentwickeln.
Disziplin: Die erste Zeit in diesem Job kann hart und anstrengend sein. Wer durchhält, wird am Ende dafür belohnt. Aus eigener Erfahrung kann ich sagen, dass die meisten im ersten Jahr mit einem guten fünfstelligen Bonus rausgehen.
Führerschein: Wäre optimal – Kundenbesuche machen wir meistens vor Ort, oder du fährst die Stopps mit unserem Poolfahrzeug ab.

Ein sehr modernes Büro, Designermöbel und Top-Hardware – wir arbeiten ausschließlich mit Apple-Geräten.
Überdurchschnittliches Gehalt durch verdammt gute Provisionen + Fixgehalt: Wir zahlen dir ein monatliches Fixum, damit du deine Kosten unabhängig von der Provision tragen kannst.
Strukturiertes Onboarding & Mentoring: Du wirst nicht ins kalte Wasser geworfen – erfahrene Consultants nehmen dich an die Hand und bringen dir alles bei, was du brauchst.
Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Wir stehen noch am Anfang unseres Wachstums – eine spätere Führungs- oder Spezialistenrolle ist dementsprechend möglich.
Incentives & Teamreisen: Es gibt regelmäßig die Möglichkeit, dich zu beweisen – dafür haben wir zum Beispiel den 911er-Cup ins Leben gerufen. Einmal im Jahr reisen wir gemeinsam als Team und suchen uns einen coolen Ort für unsere Workation.

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner Giuliana to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.
2️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with your potential manager in this role . Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.
3️⃣Additional Interview – A conversation with a senior leader from the Global Customer Success team to get a sense of how you might collaborate together and to explore team fit.
4️⃣ Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.
5️⃣Final Interview (Optional) – A final conversation with one of your main stakeholders from our Global Team.
6️⃣References & Offer!

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished.

We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

As an Engagement Manager at Harvey, you will lead AI transformation engagements at our most strategic accounts: elite law firms, Fortune 500 legal departments, and premier financial institutions. You are the person our largest customers trust to turn ambitious transformation goals into embedded, measurable change.
This is a deployment-focused role. You will own the full arc of each strategic transformation engagement, from aligning executive sponsors and mapping how the firm works today to pinpoint the highest-value workflows for Harvey, to coordinating across teams like Legal Engineering to reimagine those workflows and capture measurable impact. When an engagement reaches sustainable adoption, you hand off to the account's Customer Success Manager and move to the next challenge.

Own transformation engagements end to end. Lead strategic transformation engagements at Harvey's largest accounts. Set the plan, align stakeholders across the firm, drive execution, and hold everyone, including the customer, accountable to outcomes. You are the person making sure things actually happen.
Map workflows and target the highest-value opportunities. Work alongside customers to map how legal and professional services work is done today, identify where Harvey can have the highest impact, and build a concrete roadmap for reimagining those workflows in partnership with Legal Engineering and Legal Innovation. This isn't theoretical; you're designing real workflows that real attorneys will use.
Coordinate cross-functional delivery and capture value. Reinforce adoption through structured change management: equipping change champions, running enablement sessions, monitoring usage, and resolving blockers before they become problems.
Build executive relationships and advise on the operating model . Engage directly with senior partners, General Counsel, and legal leadership on the strategic and organizational shifts that AI-native ways of working require, including governance, talent, process, and KPIs. You are a credible advisor, not a project coordinator.
Hand off with rigor. Deliver a clear, documented account transition to the Customer Success Manager: adoption summary, open risks, recommended next steps. The handoff sets the Customer Success team up to sustain and build on what you started.
Contribute learnings to build and improve playbooks. Document what works. Contribute to Harvey's transformation methodology, templates, and frameworks so every engagement gets faster and more repeatable.
Travel required: Up to 50% of the time.
What You Have
5+ years in management consulting or senior client advisory, including time at the Engagement Manager or Project Leader level (or equivalent) where you owned a complex transformation program end to end: scoping, stakeholder alignment, delivery, and measurable outcomes. We are looking for people who have run the engagement, not only staffed it.
Experience managing large-scale technology deployments or change management programs at enterprise organizations, ideally in legal, financial services, or professional services.
Exceptional executive presence; you are comfortable leading conversations with senior partners and C-suite leaders and can build credibility quickly in demanding environments.
Strong program management instincts: you own the plan, surface risk early, and drive to outcomes rather than just managing process.
Genuine curiosity about AI and what it means for the future of legal work. You don't need to be a technologist, but you need to care deeply about the problem.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and building in environments where the playbook is still being written.

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences.

Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance.

As Commercial Strategy Analyst, you'll be part of the engine behind Halter's strategic decisions. You'll be building models, sizing opportunities, and running qualitative and quantitative analysis that shows us where to play. When the Commercial Strategy team needs to know whether a bet is worth making, they'll come to you to help build the case.
This is a role for someone who loves getting into the data and building up research. You'll turn ambiguous questions into clean, decision-ready analysis: market and opportunity sizing, scenario and sensitivity analysis, competitor analysis and broader industry trends. You'll make the complex feel simple, and give the team clear answers they can act on fast.
You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with Halter's commercial, finance, and product teams, supporting the initiatives that shape our future. You'll move between deep-focus analysis at your desk, pulling data from across the business, as well as getting out to meet farmers and ranchers so your thinking is grounded in reality.
This is a rare opportunity to build foundational analytical skills at one of the most transformative companies in agriculture - and to see your analysis directly shape major commercial decisions.

s.h: What your day could look like
s.t:
Own the quantitative analysis that underpins the Commercial Strategy team's decisions.
Source and analyse the information we need to help answer questions like where to play and how to win.
Pull together market data, competitive intelligence, and macro trends to keep our analysis current.
Support opportunity assessments for new markets, partnerships, and monetisation models with the sizing and financial structure behind them.
Translate your analysis into clear, concise charts and narratives that execs and frontline teams can quickly act on.
Partner with the Commercial Strategy Managers to take their initiatives from plan to landed outcome, owning the analytical workstream.

You love using numbers to help tell the story. Modelling in Excel or Sheets is second nature, and you take pride in files that are tidy, editable, and give clear answers without a 20-minute tour.
You can take a messy, ambiguous problem and build the data (qualitative and quantitative) that reveals the answer. You're comfortable getting an answer with half the information and refining as you learn more.
You're commercially curious. You want to understand the levers of the business and how they move.
You're rigorous and detail-oriented. You double-check your work, sanity-test your outputs, and don't let a wrong number slip through.
You communicate crisply. You can turn a complex analysis into a simple chart or one-pager that people remember and can get behind.
You build trust quickly and make people's lives easier. The team wants you in the room because you bring clarity.
You'll crush this gig if you
Live in the detail. You catch the errors others miss and you sweat the assumptions behind every number.
Tell a tight story with data. Whether it's a chart, a one-pager, or a slide, you make the complex feel simple.
Own your work, end-to-end. You run your list, hit your deadlines, and keep momentum without waiting for perfect clarity.
Are hungry to learn. You want to grow into a broader commercial strategy role and soak up everything from the team around you.
Thrive in speed and ambiguity: Startups, consulting, high-growth SaaS, agtech – wherever you've been, you got sh*t done with half the info.

Experience in a quantitative, analytical role - strategy consulting, investment banking, FP&A, data analytics, or an internal strategy team.
Exposure to agtech, SaaS, or hardware businesses.
Advanced skills in Excel/Sheets, and comfort with SQL or BI tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau) a plus.

Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together.
We're office first, not office only. Working from the office is our default, but we flex when needed. We have a high-trust culture where everyone is trusted to do what's best for Halter.
Our office vibe is special, the high energy and spectacular people make work enjoyable. Your growth and impact are unlimited here, coming from solving problems, innovating, and constantly learning from each other.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity.

World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes.

We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers.

In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered.

Our Lead / Principal Consultant - Data and AI, who we refer to internally as Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects, pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace.

We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.

As a Lead / Principal Consultant - Data and AI (referred to internally as a Lead / Principal Deployment Engineer) you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast.

You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.
This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact.
The Work You’ll Do
Initiate and Connect
Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases
Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria
Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required
Build & Value
Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements
Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights
Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer
Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot
Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies
Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact
Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance
Rollout, Adoption, and Handover
Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption
Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations
Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value
Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff
Domain & Industry Depth
Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap
What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era
You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually
You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly
You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers
You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer
You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable

Platform skills: Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python.
AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.

The Opportunity at Komodo Health
Our Evidence Intelligence team applies health economics and outcomes research (HEOR) methods to real-world healthcare data, generating insights that shape decisions for the country's leading life sciences, provider, and payer organizations.

We work at the intersection of clinical science, data analytics, and client strategy — increasingly powered by AI that lets us pair speed with quality, moving from data to decision faster than ever without compromising rigor, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful solutions to the industry's most pressing challenges.

This role also includes enablement and specialist support for Marmot, Komodo's AI platform, as we help clients and internal teams put it to work.
The Staff Consultant is both a rigorous analytic lead and a trusted advisor to clients: someone equally comfortable designing a study, defending a methodology, and sitting across the table from a client stakeholder to translate findings into action. This role exists to advance Komodo Health's mission of empowering healthcare stakeholders with data-driven, AI-augmented solutions that improve patient outcomes and healthcare delivery.
Looking back on your first 12 months at Komodo Health, you will have…
Led multiple client-facing research engagements from scoping through delivery, serving as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for key stakeholders.
Built and maintained strong, consultative relationships with client teams — proactively surfacing insights and shaping the ongoing research agenda through regular dialogue rather than one-off reports.
Developed innovative methodologies for analyzing real-world healthcare data, incorporating AI/ML and generative AI tools to accelerate analysis and improve rigor.
Established yourself as a subject matter expert in specific therapeutic areas or healthcare domains, recognized both internally and by clients.
Served as a go-to specialist for Marmot and AI-native workflows more broadly, enabling clients and colleagues to adopt and get value from Komodo's AI tools while mentoring the team on new approaches.
You will accomplish these outcomes through the following responsibilities…
Design and execute research studies using real-world healthcare data sources, applying both traditional statistical methods and emerging AI-enabled techniques.
Lead client conversations and working sessions — presenting findings, navigating questions in real time, and adjusting analysis based on client feedback.
Distill complex datasets into clear, actionable insights and communicate them through reports, presentations, and dialogue tailored to both technical and executive audiences.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, data science, clinical, sales) to integrate research insights into product development and strategy.
Evaluate and pilot new AI tools — including providing enablement and specialist support for Marmot — to improve research speed, quality, and client responsiveness, while staying current on emerging methodologies and technologies.

s.h: What you bring to Komodo Health (required)
s.t:
PhD or equivalent advanced degree in a quantitative field (e.g., epidemiology, biostatistics, health economics), or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in healthcare research or analytics, preferably in a client-facing consulting or industry setting.
Demonstrated client relationship management skills — experience leading dialogue with client stakeholders, managing expectations, and translating ambiguous questions into a clear research plan.
Experience conducting end-to-end RWE/HEOR studies, from design through dissemination using descriptive and sophisticated analysis (e.g., PSM, IPTW, and related causal inference methods).
AI-native fluency or a strong willingness to adapt: hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Gemini, internal AI assistants) to accelerate research and analysis, or a demonstrated track record of quickly learning and adopting new AI tools.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex findings into clear, actionable insights for both technical and executive audiences.
Proven track record of leading and executing research projects from inception to completion.

s.h: Additional skills and experience we’d prioritize (nice to have)…
s.t:
Experience working with real-world healthcare data sources (e.g., electronic health records, claims data).
Experience with economic modeling, including budget impact, cost-effectiveness, and cost-utility analysis.
Knowledge of healthcare industry trends, including regulatory, market, and AI-adoption dynamics.
Familiarity with advanced statistical methods for analyzing longitudinal or hierarchical data.
Experience building or using AI-powered analytics pipelines or prompt-based research tools.

Corporate Development Manager
Ebury London Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury is growing on two fronts at once: organically, into new markets and customer segments, and inorganically, through acquisitions that add capability, licences and clients faster than we could build them ourselves. Corporate Development sits at the centre of both.
We're looking for an experienced management consultant to join the team in London. The role has two facets, and you will live through both.
In the first, you'll run internal strategic projects — end-to-end reviews of the processes that determine how well Ebury actually runs.

Client onboarding is the first of these: a journey that touches Sales, Compliance, Operations, Product and Technology across multiple jurisdictions, and where the difference between good and excellent is worth a great deal in conversion, cost-to-serve and client experience.

You will diagnose it properly, size the prize, design the target state, and then stay with it until something has genuinely changed.
In the second, you'll move onto integration work behind our acquisitions — turning a deal thesis into an operating reality across systems, people, clients and regulatory permissions.
This is a role for someone who wants to stop handing over the recommendation and start owning the outcome.

The Corporate Development team, with exposure to the CEO and Executive Committee
Functional leaders across Operations, Compliance, Finance, Sales, Product and Technology, Data and Legal
Counterparties, advisers and target management teams

Strategic Projects and Internal Transformation
Own end-to-end reviews of Ebury's core operating processes, beginning with client onboarding
Map the current state honestly — cycle times, drop-off points, rework, manual intervention, cost-to-serve — and quantify where value is lost
Look at the process across different customer segments and in different jurisdictions
Design the target state, sequence it into something deliverable, and build the business case behind it
Work through functional owners to land the change, then measure whether it actually landed
Corporate Strategy and M&A Support
Market mapping, target screening, and competitive and landscape analysis
Commercial and operational due diligence support: business model, unit economics, client base quality, operational scalability
Valuation and synergy modelling, and the business case behind a recommendation to proceed
Board, ExCo and investment committee materials
Post-Merger Integration
Plan and run integration workstreams across operating model, systems, people, clients and regulatory permissions
Day 1 readiness and the 100-day plan: what must be true, by when, and who owns it
Track synergy delivery against the assumptions underwritten at deal approval, and escalate early when they slip
Act as the bridge between what was assumed in the deal model and what is true on the ground
Analysis and Decision Support
Build the financial and operational models that inform capital allocation decisions
Turn ambiguous, under-specified questions into structured recommendations an executive team can act on

s.h: Bring a view. We are not looking for neutral summaries.
s.t:
What success looks like (12–18 months)
The onboarding review is delivered, and there is a measurable improvement in cycle time, conversion and cost-to-serve that can be attributed to it
Functional leaders treat you as a partner they call early, not a reviewer they manage around
You can lead an integration workstream independently, and are trusted to represent Ebury with a target's management team
Your analysis is used in decisions at ExCo and Board level, and holds up under challenge

You have no line authority. Every change you propose is delivered by a team that doesn't report to you and already has a roadmap. Influence, credibility and follow-through are the job.
Ebury is a regulated business in many jurisdictions. Elegant operating model solutions frequently die on a licensing, permissions or local supervisory constraint. You need to find that out early, not late.
The recommendation is the easy part. Unlike consulting, you don't leave after the readout. You own the implementation and the number.
The data is not clean. You will often build the view yourself rather than request it, and be able to defend how you built it.
The work is lumpy. Deal activity is unpredictable. You may be deep in a process review one week and in a data room the next, and you need to be able to hold both.

Prior M&A or integration experience is a plus, not a requirement. We are looking for someone with genuine consulting craft, strong commercial instincts and the agency to operate without a partner above them defining the workplan.

4–7 years of management consulting experience, ideally at a Big 4 firm (Deloitte, PwC, KPMG, EY) or a comparable strategy or transaction advisory practice
A track record of owning workstreams end to end — problem definition, analysis, recommendation and client sign-off
Strong analytical toolkit: structured problem solving, financial modelling, advanced Excel, comfort working with imperfect data
Executive-grade written and verbal communication, including PowerPoint that survives a Board audience
Degree in a numerate or analytical discipline (Engineering, Economics, Business, Sciences or similar)
Fluent English, with daily collaboration across global commercial, technology and Legal/Compliance/Risk stakeholders

Exposure to financial services, payments, FX or lending
Post-merger integration, carve-out or operational due diligence experience
Experience redesigning regulated operational processes such as onboarding, KYC or credit
SQL, or fluency with BI and analytics tooling
An additional European language (Spanish, Portuguese, French, Dutch, German or Italian)

Structured Problem Solving — breaks down open-ended, under-defined questions into a workplan; sizes the opportunity before designing the fix.
Commercial Judgement — understands how operational decisions land in revenue, margin and risk; prioritises on business impact rather than analytical interest.
Delivery Bias — measures success by what changed, not by what was presented; stays with a project past the readout.
Influence Without Authority — builds credibility with functional owners quickly, and gets change delivered through teams that don't report to them.
Comfort with Ambiguity — operates without a defined workplan or a partner above them; high agency, low need for structure.
Intellectual Honesty — reports the finding that is inconvenient, including when it kills their own recommendation.
Regulatory Literacy — willing to get into the detail of licensing, permissions and compliance constraints rather than treating them as someone else's problem.

At Senior Consultant level
You will independently lead defined projects or workstreams, with responsibility for day-to-day client engagement, programme management, risk control, technical coordination and high-quality delivery outputs. You will manage agreed scope and commercial controls, support procurement activity and build confidence in leading increasingly complex integration challenges.
You will contribute to proposals and client relationship activity, share learning with colleagues and help create a collaborative, high-performing delivery environment.
At Principal Consultant level
You will lead complex commissions, interdependent workstreams or portfolios of projects, with greater responsibility for client confidence, commercial performance, delivery governance and senior stakeholder decisions. You will lead selected bids and extensions, provide credible challenge across technical and programme interfaces and help resolve issues that cut across individual workstreams.
You will also mentor colleagues, raise delivery standards and make a visible contribution to the growth of the Building Integration capability.
Future growth toward Associate Director
This role provides a route toward Associate Director for someone who demonstrates sustained impact beyond individual commissions. At that level, the focus grows to leading major client relationships, building a capable team, developing future leaders, shaping the Building Integration proposition and pipeline, and taking appropriate responsibility for resource and revenue decisions.
Formal line management is not required at appointment. However, we expect the successful candidate to help build and, over time, potentially lead a growing team with care, inclusion, clarity and accountability.

Essential experience and capability
· experience leading client-side technology, IT infrastructure, workplace technology or related delivery projects in commercial occupier, workplace, construction or fit-out environments
· a track record of managing scope, programme, risk, budget, stakeholders and delivery partners on complex or high-visibility work
· practical experience of technology infrastructure such as networks, communications rooms, structured cabling, telecommunications, cloud or on-premises environments and audiovisual systems
· the ability to coordinate the interfaces between IT infrastructure, smart-building systems, operational technology, building management systems and wider construction or fit-out delivery
· strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, including the confidence to explain complex issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
· a proactive, resourceful approach to identifying risks, pursuing decisions and keeping delivery moving
· a recognised project-management qualification such as PRINCE2, PMP, APM PMQ or AgilePM, or equivalent demonstrable professional project-delivery experience
· experience gained either client-side or with a technology integrator, contractor or other delivery organisation, with the judgement to operate successfully in a client-side advisory and assurance role
Desirable experience
· experience aligning technology delivery with RIBA Plan of Work stages, construction programmes or major fit-out activity
· experience of technology procurement, tender and request-for-proposal processes, supplier evaluation or contract management

You will be a visible and trusted presence both on-site and within local communities—driving engagement initiatives, supporting events, and strengthening meaningful connections.
This position involves weekly travel to remote sites, with flexibility required to extend time onsite to support mobilisation and operational priorities.

Theme nights celebrations
NAIDOC Week

Identify local project and service opportunities
Collaborate internally to deliver shared outcomes

Monitor, evaluate, and report on community engagement outcomes and social value contributions

Ensure compliance with Sodexo policies, Indigenous engagement commitments, and client expectations

Approachable, engaging, and culturally aware
Highly organised with strong documentation and reporting capability
Passionate about community development and social impact
Able to work autonomously across remote locations
Flexible, adaptable, and comfortable in dynamic environments

Préparer et animer des ateliers de travail et réunions clients

Contribuer activement à la satisfaction client par la qualité des analyses, la rigueur méthodologique et la pertinence des recommandations
Identifier des opportunités de développement sur vos comptes

Encadrer et accompagner les consultants juniors dans la réalisation de leurs travaux
Assurer la montée en compétences des équipes sur les dimensions analytiques et méthodologiques
Contribuer à la dynamique collective de l’équipe (formations internes, partages d’expérience, mentoring)
Promouvoir une culture d’exigence, de collaboration et d’amélioration continue

Participer aux réponses à appels d’offres et aux propositions commerciales
Contribuer à la structuration et à l’enrichissement des offres de Tensquare
Produire des contenus à forte valeur ajoutée (études sectorielles, benchmarks, points de vue)
